messages:
Sam Chen: Heads-up — CI evals for quantized-2b are showing a reproducible drop on a small subset of holdout prompts. Not noise; same prompts across runs. Anyone seen this pattern before?
Priya Rao: hmm, saw something similar last month. Often ends up being an RNG/seeding desync between the runner and fixture generator.
Jordan K: infra note: we recently changed the eval runner to use a multiprocessing pool for shuffling. That can change ordering if seeds aren't propagated per worker.
Sam Chen: here's the failing snippet from the CI logs: 
```
INFO runner: run_id=2026-03-17-4821 seed=4821
DEBUG fixture-loader: shuffle_seed=2921
WARN metric: holdout-match-rate drop -3.9% (baseline 0.672 -> 0.647)
```
Sam Chen: see mismatch between run seed and fixture shuffle_seed — those should be the same.
Maria Lopez: also remember the fixture rotation script wrote files concurrently; files got emitted in non-deterministic order recently. If our eval relies on file order for cohorting, that produces apparent leakage/regressions.
Priya Rao: proposed quick wins: 1) ensure runner and fixture generator derive from a single top-level SeedSequence; 2) add deterministic_shuf flag to runner; 3) add fixture checksum + index metadata so loader can sort reliably.
Jordan K: agreed. I'm happy to add deterministic_shuf support in the pool wrapper — pass a distinct child seed per worker via SeedSequence.spawn(n_workers).
Sam Chen: minimal patch I sketched: 
```
# runner.shuffle_children(seed, n)
parent = np.random.SeedSequence(seed)
children = parent.spawn(n)
rgs = [np.random.default_rng(s.entropy) for s in children]
# worker gets rng = rgs[worker_id]
```
Priya Rao: tiny nit: use s.generate_state(1)[0] or .entropy? we want reproducible streams across numpy versions. But main idea stands. Also add torch.manual_seed(seed) for model ops.
Maria Lopez: for the fixture writer: write a manifest.json next to each batch with stable ids and a sha256 of the batch file. Loader will sort by manifest.index then assert sha matches. That will catch silent reorderings.
Sam Chen: eval-bot, can you paste the failing CI job with artifacts?
eval-bot: CI summary: job eval/quantized-2b/2178 failed 3 runs. Artifacts: https://ci.redwood/artefacts/eval/2178 (contains logs+holdout-diffs). First failure shows seed mismatch at 2178001234.
Sam Chen: putting together a small PR to do: propagate seed from ci config -> fixture-gen -> runner; add --deterministic-shuffle flag; add manifest + checksum in fixture write. Will open shortly.
Jordan K: leave a TODO to backfill existing fixtures with manifests so older runs can be audited.
Priya Rao: add a unit test that runs runner twice with same seed and asserts identical example ordering + model logits (within epsilon). That will catch regressions in shuffle or batch ordering.
Maria Lopez: also add a simple integr test in CI matrix: single-worker vs multi-worker parity. Helps guard future perf patches.
Sam Chen: thanks all. I'll open PR and tag @pri, @jordan, @maria for review. Assigning myself. :rocket: 
Priya Rao: :thumbsup: please include the checksum update in the eval metrics exporter too so we can track historical mismatches.
Jordan K: will review tonight. If urgent we can cherry-pick to the canary branch.
Sam Chen: ETA: will have PR up in ~2h.
Maria Lopez: nice, thanks.
Sam Chen: follow-up note — PR link: https://git.redwood/r/infra/runner/pulls/458 (draft) — includes tests and manifest writer.
Priya Rao: looked quick — LGTM overall, left 2 tiny comments on seed propagation.
Jordan K: approved locally, will push small pool wrapper tweak after tests.
Sam Chen: merging to canary once green. Will monitor eval-dash for the next 6 runs and report back. :eyes:
